categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:74 of Block 3) in Aluthgama village. It involves land ownership determination, cadastral mapping, and formal registration of property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
